name: Position Set Collateral Dimensions 3
definition: Variables related to derivatives that are used to group derivatives together into positions for collateral position sets and currency collateral position sets reports.

CounterpartyIdentification.name: Counterparty Identification
CounterpartyIdentification.definition: Data specific to counterparties and related fields.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Information indicating the type of collateral agreement existing between counterparties.

InitialMarginPostedCurrency.name: Initial Margin Posted Currency
InitialMarginPostedCurrency.definition: Currency of the initial margin posted by the reporting counterparty to the other counterparty.

VariationMarginPostedCurrency.name: Variation Margin Posted Currency
VariationMarginPostedCurrency.definition: Currency of the variation margin posted, including cash settled, by the reporting counterparty to the other counterparty.

InitialMarginReceivedCurrency.name: Initial Margin Received Currency
InitialMarginReceivedCurrency.definition: Currency of the initial margin received by the reporting counterparty from the other counterparty.

VariationMarginReceivedCurrency.name: Variation Margin Received Currency
VariationMarginReceivedCurrency.definition: Currency of the variation margin received, including cash settled, by the reporting counterparty from the other counterparty.

ExcessCollateralPostedCurrency.name: Excess Collateral Posted Currency
ExcessCollateralPostedCurrency.definition: Currency of collateral posted in excess of the required collateral.

ExcessCollateralReceivedCurrency.name: Excess Collateral Received Currency
ExcessCollateralReceivedCurrency.definition: Currency of collateral received in excess of the required collateral.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
